failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of DMF exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 120°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Particulate formation or deposition in BPR
failure_modes.mitigation: Install inline filter before BPR and schedule regular maintenance

failure_modes.cause: Exothermic reaction due to unexpected impurities
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement real-time temperature monitoring and automated shutdown

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank DMF at Q=0.14726 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Conduct thermal stability test with impurities at 120°C to assess exothermic potential
Perform inline filter efficiency test to evaluate particulate capture before BPR
